title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Trezor, BitBox warn users about fake hardware wallet security alerts
summary: BitBox said multiple Bitcoin companies appeared to have been targeted through a shared newsletter provider, while Trezor confirmed a breach at its email service.

title: US sanctions Xinbi scam marketplace, restrains $52M in crypto
summary: The Justice Department seized Xinbi’s Telegram channels and two wallets as investigators pursued 47 additional wallets across its alleged laundering network.

title: DoubleZero adds Kalshi election market data ahead of US midterms
summary: The expansion gives institutional and automated traders real-time access to Kalshi’s political markets as election betting activity continues to grow.

title: Consensys to split into MetaMask and institutional blockchain company
summary: The restructuring will separate MetaMask’s consumer business from Consensys’ Ethereum protocols and institutional blockchain infrastructure operations.

title: TRM Labs doubles valuation to $2B in Series C expansion
summary: The blockchain intelligence firm said its annual recurring revenue has quadrupled over the past three years as it expands its AI-powered investigations business.

title: US Bank tests proprietary stablecoin in cross-border Stellar transaction
summary: The pilot moved USBDC between the bank’s North American and European entities on the public Stellar blockchain.

title: Bitcoin fails to reclaim $80K as Bessent fuels yen strength around 153 per dollar
summary: Bitcoin trended lower with US stocks on Iran escalation while US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent contributed to fears of a yen carry-trade unwind.

title: Hunter Biden’s laptop controversy gets a memecoin afterlife
summary: The project’s disclosures say LAPTOP has no utility, lock founder tokens for six months and reserve 2% for wallets that lost money on TRUMP.

title: Trade groups seek to block Illinois crypto tax before January effective date
summary: Following on their earlier lawsuit, CCI and the Blockchain Association seek to block Illinois’ 0.2% crypto tax, arguing it is unconstitutional and would impose costly compliance burdens.
